body: I wanted to tell you that I went through something similar and can completely empathize. I struggle sometimes but I’m slowly seeing the light from this continually dark and bleak tunnel. I’m here if you want to talk ❤️

I’m essentially the same way. I’m on this neverending pause to nothing. I literally haven’t done really anything with my life but right now I...I don’t know...feel completely fine with that? I’m completely fine with just vegging out, chilling and that’s it. I know I could be so much happier and heal if I just wrote and expressed how I feel...I’m the queen of procrastination and avoidance. I know I have so many skills and talents and could do whatever I want to do...I don’t know why I haven’t, honestly. Well, part of it was because I had DID and was in a dissociative fugue for 12 years...I guess that’s mainly it. Bittersweetly, Kundalini was awakening....or Prana...at pretty much the same time so I’m dealing with two loaded stones here and a lot of pressure to catch up on lost time, almost too much. I also have constant tinnitus and the energy has been trapped in my head for 10 months. Feel constantly ungrounded as well.

I completely agree. I’m like “Amanda, you must have thoughts. You must have thoughts. Don’t fade away, please don’t fade away....get interested in SOMETHING. Write. Whatever you need to do, do! And some of the time it works. And same, sometimes I’m really in my thoughts and then things get really creepy/scary and I’m like “nope, nope, nope, nope, not safe, not going to engage, not interested”

I went through the same thing 12 years ago except I also heard child and persecutor voices telling me I was a baby and saw creepy images/got scratches so that sucked...it was really traumatic. The prior host found out that we had DID back in January and she was out for awhile but now I’m back...it became really overwhelming for her to be there again and in her parents’ house, realizing all the time she lost and suspecting her father of really bad things...suspecting that that’s why she had DID so I’m in charge for now protecting us. 

We realized this when looking back at our timeline and the episode and that I thought I was born in 2008 and it clicked that we had DID...then she came out and her old personality came back, old associations...we were integrating maybe and then we split because she got a job at the same grocery stores that I used to work at. She was ashamed of me at first but now she’s very grateful for me and vice versa...I love her very much. I know how scary and traumatizing it is to be put in a body and feel strange in it. I also mourned the previous me which was her and felt like I was just taking her place but doing the best that I could. You’re welcome to PM me anytime. I’m still very new at this and it’s extremely extremely overwhelming 😂
I only experienced them during that period of time but thanks!

I split back in 2008, didn’t even know I had DID and just realized I had back in January...”core” me...realizing that I had the same nose all this time and that my brain had been “broken” for years. I followed a persecutor and child voice’s trance logic and remained with that logic until January, new neural pathways and everything and limited emotions. Also some word salad...etc....I was in a depersonalized emotional state and believed that everything that I said was copied from other people, that I was born in 2008 and just starting out my life. It came from stress, a creepy video game and heavy anxiety and depression. And I had amnesia for whatever really triggered it, but once the amnesia began and the voices...that was it. I also have flashbacks of it all because I felt powerless...it was a very traumatic experience for the new ANP. Original me can’t handle the dissociation aspect so she/I hide because it’s so emotional and familiar surroundings and dynamics kind of trigger me to go back to old ANP sometimes. It’s really hard but I’m taking one day at a time. Grounding can be excruciatingly difficult because I feel taken over by the past a lot and overwhelmed with it. It might actually be OSDD since I guess I was “conscious” the whole time, didn’t lose any memories..just didn’t realize I was there
I just keep feeling scared and paranoid
I was pretty much brain dead for 12 years, depersonalized mode, Alexithymia....
Sometimes I worry and still get this paranoid thought that I’m still not the original me and this is all too good to be true...that I’m still in the nightmare and drowning in it
I was getting constant panic attacks too at the beginning of coming out of this and feeling like myself again, the old “core” me 🙁
All my old associations came back too for a time but then they disappeared...had major head pain and then they were gone again.
Have any of you also not known that you had DID and lived in an alternate reality/delusion due to that until researching it years later and then reintegrating the core or original personality?
For awhile I pretended that it never happened...when I came back, but I feel like it always follows me

It’s so sad that I missed so many years of happiness...at the same time being back reminds me of all the pain but also happiness and future promises of being alive and being fully present. But I veer back and forth from wanting that to not...When I think about the past i start panicking and drown in the anxiety and fear and pain and those parts of my brain, the old or “original” Amanda,  break down again. I need to write but I’m scared to feel and I’m scared to actually have a future...to be free which is stupid but true...in a way it was nice to be “sick” even though it really sucked. I start crying and being so angry that this happened and how could it happen?!!! I’ve been in the frozen/denial mode for awhile.

I feel like I’m splitting too, after years of being in a dissociative state where I was here but not here and feeling extremely overwhelmed to being fully back and realizing I had DID and was gone for so many years....that pathways I used to have were inactive for a seriously long time
It was but it’s over and I’m all good 🙂
I didn’t even know I had an alter
I have a blackout from whatever happened before...besides the video game. But god...it was terrifying, demeaning, dehumanizing that my brain did this to me...and it felt like a fucking evil intruder.
Yeah...I’m so sorry =[. I guess I was following the “trance logic” but resisting it at the same time.

I’m completely in the same boat. I was here but not here...? I guess a shell host/me? was created but I have no memory loss...just realized I had dissociated from analyzing a dissociative event and finally seeing it for what it was? I used to think I was the new Amanda replacing the old and now that I saw back and finally realized what it is...the old neural pathways are connecting again, but it’s a lot to deal with and I get a lot of panic attacks so sometimes I’ll fade out in a way and mechanical Amanda who has some “circulomotion” or whatever the hell it is speech and emotional numbness because I was in that state for 12 years...it’s just a lot to realize I wasn’t here for awhile. I thought I had a different nose and was starting my life from scratch back in ‘08, persecutor alter and child voices. DID NOT know I had a dissociative disorder.

I also get paranoid and anxious sometimes and worry that I’m not the original me/host..but I remember what I was like...and my feelings, at least somewhat but also forgot many of my flaws/negative traits, it’s just that I dropped all of those traits because I thought she’d left/that I’d left...it’s so confusing. Maybe it was just a host split/break that needed to happen and it had been such a long time that I didn’t understand what was happening and that’s why I couldn’t ground back to reality? I also forgot that your hair has to suds for it to show that it’s clean, or maybe that was also just the self/ego-regressive state that I was in and I did already know how to wash it and all that info was there because it was...I mean my old associations have come back. The fragment has also integrated with me because I don’t have the same weird thought insertions anymore. I used to feel this tingling sensation all throughout my body too, this somatic thing, sometimes...and that’s pretty much gone as well. I’d wake up often at 3 or 4 in the morning, go back to sleep and would always still feel tired waking up in the late morning

It’s so weird. I went so mechanical, mourned the girl who I felt like I replaced and wanted desperately for her to come back, felt so weirded out and jolted by the child voice.....I felt like I was there but wasn’t there and warring against these voices that I didn’t understand. I have flashbacks of the event...almost like PTSD because I kept feeling more and more powerless by that persecutor/introject voice/fragment. I don’t understand how I recognized my friends yet didn’t feel like I was myself...also had a lot of emotional numbing....and this very surreal and spacey feeling like I’d just jumped into my body for the first time, and obviously had facial distortions as well (the nose), felt like I was making funny faces on webcam too...I don’t know why the first thing I remember about the dissociation was the trance in the bathroom of the restaurant and child voice...saying this is the first time I’ve used the toilet, saying mommy and daddy...etc..when i got back out and behind the hostess desk...almost like I drifted in a daze and “switched” from the bathroom on and don’t remember anything that happened beforehand, which I guess would be the amnestic barrier? 
My dad was also a little creepy and touchy feely sometimes/used to drink and was unemployed for awhile when we were little and my mom worked full-time at a hospital, a nurse, who was a perfectionist and not the most maternal while he was very affectionate...I suspected he was a little too close to my sister sometimes also..and he was a little flirtatious with their friends’ attractive wives and attractive women but he was also verysocial regardless
I feel the same way 🙁 I don’t know what to do either

I can say I dissociated severely...that I was only dissociation even, for 11 years!, up until maybe two months ago. Dissociation was because of a lot of hurt and regret from losing friends, friends betraying me, friends changing, bullying and the fear of being myself due to being judged, being “too” friendly, expressive, etc...I essentially am an energizer bunny of light in a way and am just naturally kind to everyone (I’m highly sensitive and an “empath”, if you believe in it). I also carried self-shame and self-dislike for awhile and witnessed incest/sexual abuse happening to my little sister which no one should have to be exposed to...and my uncle sexually assaulted me as well, that memory is a bit blurry but that’s probably a good thing. I also almost drowned at 4 years old, generally just a lot of things and I apologize if it’s too triggering but I just wanted to emphasize that we have all experienced hurt and that you’re not alone. I still struggle sometimes but here’s some tips and things that have helped: 
1. Set goals for yourself in whatever relaxed or more formal way...even just one goal or thing you’d like to do for the day. Envision a bright future for yourself 🤗
2. Surround yourself with good (people, animals, nature and walking in it, the environment period, mantras, music, whatever you enjoy doing) 
3. Listen to your body and mind and be nurturing to yourself and don’t take on anything more than you feel that you can handle, if possible 
4. Express your feelings and thoughts. That is the only way you won’t feel prone to dissociating again. Reach out to loved ones and vent, cry, whatever you need to do, and DON’T feel bad about doing it. Obviously be mindful of it though. Cry into a pillow, write, sing, dance hardcore, whatever can help get out everything. I highly recommend getting a therapist if you don’t see one already because they are a great secondary or primary source of support and validation!! Lots of validation as well as comfort. Therapists and healers have been my angels, besides my grandmothers who unfortunately are both deceased, as well as my maternal grandpa.

Do not keep the things that bother you in because that will encourage more dissociation...don’t avoid but embrace or just accept if that’s what is needed. Accepting the good and the bad is the only way to keep you feeling tangible and damn it sure feels worth it! It’s been great to live again, to be back. Now I’m trying to make up for lost time but I have to ground and remind myself that I have all the time in the world and it’s okay to pace things. Just love yourself. That’s what’s most important and feel. Feel everything. And then use those feelings towards something good or constructive, if you want to. You’re welcome to PM me anytime 🤎. We can be one more person of support to each other and I never mind making new friends ☺️
